displayDescription: A challenge cue passes its accent to the idea, five connections light up and each one adds a point until the score reads 5/5.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: STYLE.json lists no reviewed preview recipes, so this preview shows the Motion Graphic's main action: challenge, then countdown, then the accent passes to the performer, then the score registers.
No BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so no source-frame evidence was used. The deep indigo stage comes from the subject illustration, not from a reviewed source palette.
Stage lighting is a flat vector approximation (gradient spotlight cone, radial floor glow and bulb halo). There is no physical light simulation.
The 'performer' is the idea bulb, a symbolic silhouette rather than a person. The score display is original programme graphics.
